attacks.name: Spider Talons
steps: After this attack is resolved, this character gains |!power| equal to the |!damage| dealt.
|!wild| |*Pierce|: Change 1 of the defender's |!critical|, |!wild|, or |!block| results to a Blank.
|!wild| |*Heal|: After this attack is resolved, if it dealt 1 or more |!damage|, this character may remove 1 |!damage| from itself.

attacks.name: Organic Web Shot
steps: After this attack is resolved, this character gains 1 |!power|.
|!hit| |*Pursuit|: Before |!damage| is dealt, this character may Advance Toward the defender |!movement_small|.

attacks.name: 2099 Sends Its Regards
steps: Before |!damage| is dealt, the defender gains the |§poison§Poison| and |§stun§Stun| special conditions.
After this attack is resolved, this character may Place itself within |!range| 1 of the defender.
|!wild| |*Throw|: Before |!damage| is dealt, if the defender is |!size| 4 or less, this character may Throw it Away |!movement_small|.

superPowers.name: Web Whip
superPowers.body: Choose an enemy character within |!range| 3 and in LOS and Push it Toward this character |!movement_small|. Then, Place this character within |!range| 1 of the chosen character. This superpower can be used only once per Turn.

superPowers.name: Acceleration Decoy
superPowers.body: While this character is defending, during the |*Modify Dice| step of the attack, it may use this superpower. This character may reroll any number of its defense dice, including |!failure| results. After the attack is resolved, this character may Place itself within |!range| 2 of its current position.

superPowers.name: Future Tech Genius
superPowers.body: When this character rolls dice, after the effect is resolved, it gains 1 |!power| if it rolled at least 1 |!critical|. When this character attacks, it ignores the |*Stealth| |!innate| superpower and the defender does not benefit from Cover.
